items.exampleEn: Honey is a sticky, sweet substance made by bees.
items.exampleZh: 蜂蜜是蜜蜂製造的一種黏稠甜美的物質。

items.exampleEn: The new coach brought discipline to a team that often arrived late.
items.exampleZh: 新教練為這支常常遲到的隊伍帶來了紀律。

items.exampleEn: The museum invites educators to plan lessons using its art collection.
items.exampleZh: 博物館邀請教育工作者利用館藏規劃課程。

items.exampleEn: A careful observer will notice that the two paintings are slightly different.
items.exampleZh: 細心的觀察者會發現這兩幅畫有些微不同。

items.exampleEn: Biological research helps farmers grow stronger plants.
items.exampleZh: 生物研究幫助農民種出更強壯的植物。

items.exampleEn: Shops use color psychology to make customers feel relaxed.
items.exampleZh: 商店利用色彩心理學讓顧客感到放鬆。

items.exampleEn: Diamonds are made of pure carbon.
Aluminum is light, so it is often used to build airplanes.
items.exampleZh: 鋁很輕，所以常被用來製造飛機。

items.sentenceEn: Please put empty aluminum cans in the blue recycling bin.
items.sentenceZh: 請把空鋁罐放進藍色回收桶。

items.audioEn: Our psychology class has been moved to Room 12 because the screen in the usual room is broken.
items.audioZh: 我們的心理學課改到 12 教室，因為原本教室的螢幕壞了。
options: The usual room is being painted

items.sentenceEn: Trees take in carbon from the air as they grow.
items.sentenceZh: 樹木在生長時會從空氣中吸收碳。

items.sentenceEn: The famous educator believed that every child learns in a different way.
items.sentenceZh: 那位知名教育家相信每個孩子的學習方式都不同。

items.stemEn: The scientists found an unknown ____ in the water and sent it to a lab for testing.
items.stemZh: 科學家在水中發現一種未知物質，並送到實驗室檢驗。

items.stemEn: Birds have a ____ clock that tells them when to fly south.
items.stemZh: 鳥類有一個生理時鐘，告訴牠們何時該往南飛。

items.passageEn: My cousin is studying to become an educator, and her favorite subject is psychology. This term, she spent a month in a primary school as an observer. She sat at the back of the classroom and took notes on how children learn. She noticed that good teachers did not need strict discipline; instead, they kept lessons lively. In one science lesson, the children tested which substances float in water, including small pieces of carbon and aluminum. My cousin also learned about the biological reasons why young children need plenty of sleep. She told me the month was exhausting, but she had never felt so happy.
items.passageZh: 我表姊正在讀書準備當教育工作者，她最喜歡的科目是心理學。這學期，她在一所小學當了一個月的觀察員。她坐在教室後面，記錄孩子們怎麼學習。她注意到好老師不需要嚴格的紀律，而是讓課堂保持活潑。在一堂自然課上，孩子們測試哪些物質會浮在水上，包括小塊的碳和鋁。表姊也學到幼兒需要充足睡眠的生理原因。她跟我說，這個月很累人，但她從來沒有這麼開心過。

questions.questionZh: 表姊在小學裡擔任什麼角色？
表姊注意到好老師怎麼做？

items.promptZh: 學一種樂器需要耐心和自律。
referenceEn: Learning a musical instrument takes patience and discipline.
You need patience and discipline to learn an instrument.
rubricZh: discipline 指「自律、紀律」，不可數（例如 patience and discipline）

items.promptZh: 昨天的會議有幾位來自其他學校的觀察員。
referenceEn: There were several observers from other schools at yesterday's meeting.
Several observers from other schools attended the meeting yesterday.
rubricZh: observer 指觀察員，這裡用複數（例如 several observers、a few observers 等）
昨天的事用過去式（例如 there were、attended 等）
